statement: An organisation administrator shall be able to create a user account with a unique email address.
Only user accounts with Active status shall be permitted to sign in.
An organisation administrator shall be able to deactivate an existing user account.
An organisation administrator shall be able to create and edit roles and their permitted actions.
Users shall not access information belonging to another organisation.
Users shall be able to filter available agents by category and keyword.
Each catalogue entry shall display its agent name, short description and category.
The portal shall display purchased and promotional credit balances separately.
The portal shall display a combined available credit balance calculated from purchased and promotional credits.
An authorised administrator shall be able to grant sample promotional credits to a selected organisation.
The system shall record each administrator-issued credit adjustment in a transaction log.
An organisation administrator shall be able to view AI request usage totals for a selected reporting period.
An authorised administrator shall be able to assign a monthly usage quota to a user.
An authorised auditor shall be able to search administrative operation logs by date and action type.
Every log record shall include an event timestamp, actor and action.
The portal could allow users to save favourite agents for quick access.
The portal could support a comparison view for up to three agents.
The interface shall communicate validation errors beside the affected form field.
